# Each three-line window holds every redundant copy of its oldest batch across
# four sends. Windows are spread across the harness's repeated START presses so
# at least one crosses a press or release edge on machines with different
# emulation speeds. A run still fails unless a real prediction mismatch causes
# checkpoint restore and replay; mere packet delay cannot pass it.
